Species.Description: It focuses electricity through its psychic power and glides over the ground while riding its tail like a surfboard.
Abundant tropical sunlight stretched its neck skyward. Its tail head can act independently to protect the towering body.
After losing a struggle for territory, it adapted to life on land. A poisonous film protects its body from drying out.
A departed Zorua was reborn in Hisui after its spiteful spirit gathered power. It disguises itself to terrify its foes.
Its bitter illusions are so powerful that they can physically harm foes, though it protects companions it trusts.
Its sturdy claws and poison adapted to harsh highlands, where it scales steep cliffs with ease.
Its long claws carry a potent poison, and its strength lets it race freely across sheer mountain walls.
It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. When attacked, it pushes poisonous spines from its back to defend itself.
It is active at night and commands a nest's ordinary Rattata while searching for fresh food.
Its discerning palate makes it hoard only the freshest ingredients for its colony.
It adapted to snowy mountains, gaining a steel-hard hide that slides swiftly over ice.
Its icy spines are steel-hard and shed snow in glittering sprays when it moves.
It exhales air colder than winter snow and lives peacefully on high frozen peaks.
Revered as a snowy mountain guardian, it guides the lost with glittering ice crystals.
Metallic whiskers sense its surroundings and grow strong in mineral-rich volcanic soil.
Its long golden whiskers act as sensors and are treated as signs of good fortune.
Once raised by royalty, it became proud, fickle, and especially fond of glittering treasure.
Its round face and elegant coat are prized, though it can be calculating and cruel.
Magnetic stone in its body makes iron sand cling to its surface and crackle with electricity.
It feeds on dravite and fires electrically charged rocks when angered.
It launches charged boulders from its back with enough force to shake distant ground.
It stores toxins inside its body, keeping its surroundings unexpectedly clean as it feeds.
Countless toxins swirl through its vivid body while crystals along it act like poisonous fangs.
It honors lost companions through solemn dances, setting both ends of its bone ablaze.
Life in an ancient forest filled it with psychic energy that shimmers through its mane.
It reads wicked intent and strikes with psychic power focused through its horn.
A diet of spicy seeds changed the particles stored in its body and sharpened its reactions.
A Shellder clamped onto its arm, turning their combined toxins into a powerful launcher.
It consumes polluted air and releases purified gases from the tall crowns on its heads.
Its psychic power freezes a target's movement as surely as bitter winter air.
Its mighty legs carry it across mountains at incredible speed before it strikes with crushing kicks.
An evil aura burns like flame around it, exhausting the spirit of anyone it touches.
A Shellder's bite awakened strange intellect and lets it mix uncanny poisonous brews.
